speaker: (the pedlar)
text: Ballad sheets. A penny. The tune is in the singing, not in a title.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One sheet. A penny. It is for a girl who cannot read it. She will have it if she hears it once.

speaker: (the pedlar)
text: Then do not lose the tune between here and wherever she is. A penny, and it is yours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny. I am not buying a second, and I am not asking you to name it.

speaker: (the pedlar)
text: Take it folded. The road past Aylesbury is long enough to forget a tune. Do not.
